source: prototype gown_maker_v207.html (specs 29bce1c), captured headless on three 0.160 at 1280 px (a desktop: 1,500 flowers drawn) with a window.__gx hook and the skirt at rest: 3D flowers (anchors, hidden, the drawn matrices as position, outward axis and width axis), scattered pearls, the veil over flowers, the quote and summary lines, and the rules step by step. v200 crashes placing veil-edge pearls in the veil's first build, so each case is built once without pearls, then with them. Names mapped to the contract: laceRaise -> laceFinish, pearlAt -> pearls, flowerType bloom -> petal, glitter_tulle -> glitter. Re-captured on v207: the skirt now falls in the fabric's own uneven folds and the train has a rounded end.
